--csv.help: Save output to a comma separated value file.

--db.help: SQLite 3 file to save found records.

--dictionary.help: Dictionary file of subdomain and hostnames to use for brute force.

--disable_check_bindversion.help: Disables check for BIND version on name servers

--disable_check_nxdomain.help: Disables check for NXDOMAIN hijacking on name servers.

--disable_check_recursion.help: Disables check for recursion on name servers

--disable_recurs.help: Disable recursion desired flag in queries.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--host.help: IP address to listen on default is 127.0.0.1

--input-list.help: File containing a list of domains to perform DNS enumeration on, one per line.

--iw.help: Continue brute forcing a domain even if a wildcard record is discovered.

--json.help: save output to a JSON file.

--lifetime.help: Time to wait for a server to respond to a query. default is 3.0

--log-level.help: Set logging level, default is info but [critical|error|warning|info|debug|trace] can be set

--loglevel.help: Log level to use. default is INFO

--name_server.help: Domain server to use. If none is given, the SOA of the target will be used. Multiple servers can be specified using a comma separated list.

--port.help: Port to bind the web server to, default is 5000

--range.help: IP range for reverse lookup brute force in formats (first-last) or in (range/bitmask).

--rate-limit.help: Set API rate limit (e.g., "10/minute", "100/hour"), default is 5/minute

--reload.help: Enable automatic reload used during development of the api

--shodan.help: Use Shodan to query netblocks discovered via SPF (-s) and/or Whois (-w) during standard enumeration.

--shodan-active.help: Actively validate Shodan-discovered names by resolving them and confirming they still match the queried netblock.

--shodan-key.help: Shodan API key. If omitted, SHODAN_API_KEY environment variable is used.

--tcp.help: Use TCP protocol to make queries.

--threads.help: Number of threads to use in reverse lookups, forward lookups, brute force and SRV record enumeration.

--type.help: Type of enumeration to perform. Possible types: std: SOA, NS, A, AAAA, MX and SRV. rvl: Reverse lookup of a given CIDR or IP range. brt: Brute force domains and hosts using a given dictionary. srv: SRV records. axfr: Test all NS servers for a zone transfer. bing: Perform Bing search for subdomains and hosts. yand: Perform Yandex search for subdomains and hosts. crt: Perform crt.sh search for subdomains and hosts. caa: CAA records. snoop: Perform cache snooping against all NS servers for a given domain, testing all with file containing the domains, file given with -D option.

--xml.help: XML file to save found records.

-b.help: Perform Bing enumeration with standard enumeration.

-f.help: Filter out of brute force domain lookup, records that resolve to the wildcard defined IP address when saving records.

-g.help: Perform Google enumeration with standard enumeration.

-k.help: Perform crt.sh enumeration with standard enumeration.

-s.help: Perform a reverse lookup of IPv4 ranges in the SPF record with standard enumeration.

-w.help: Perform deep whois record analysis and reverse lookup of IP ranges found through Whois when doing a standard enumeration.

-y.help: Perform Yandex enumeration with standard enumeration.

-z.help: Performs a DNSSEC zone walk with standard enumeration.
